name: Lakeside Film Festival
description: For the 12th year, Lakeside Film Festival transforms a hidden lake and former GDR holiday camp into a weekend-long open-air cinema experience. Set in the lush forests of Schlaubetal Nature Park, just a couple hours from Berlin, the festival features four outdoor cinema stages under the stars screening film festival hits, cult classics, trippy horrors, stoner comedies, bold docs, and quirky shorts. By day, attendees cool off in the private lake, attend a famous film quiz, live performances, karaoke, and DJ sets. The campsite offers a beautiful escape combining nature, film culture, and community spirit—easily accessible by train with a free shuttle bus from Grunow station.
